stem: What is one way the farmer’s experience in the story "Do What You Can" is DIFFERENT from Anansi’s experience in the story "How Six Sons Rescued Anansi"?

options.label: A
options.text: The farmer changes by the end of the story, but Anansi does not change.

options.label: B
options.text: The farmer learns a lesson, while Anansi teaches a lesson.

options.label: C
options.text: The farmer’s feelings about his situation stay the same, but Anansi’s feelings about his situation improve.

options.label: D
options.text: The farmer’s problem is caused by nature, while Anansi’s problem is caused by an accident.
